(NOT APPROVED)

  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  JULY 27, 2026

A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Torosis at 5:33 p.m., on
Monday, July 27, 2026, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA.

Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Caroline Torosis
  Councilmember Lana Negrete
  Councilmember Dan Hall (arrived at 5:34 p.m.)
  Councilmember Ellis Raskin
  Councilmember Barry Snell
  Councilmember Natalya Zernitskaya

  Absent:  Mayor Pro Tem Jesse Zwick

  Also Present:  City Manager Oliver Chi
  City Attorney Heidi von Tongeln
  Interim City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

 CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 5:33 p.m., with all
  members present except Councilmember Hall and Mayor Pro Tem
  Zwick. Councilmember Snell led the assemblage in the Pledge of
  Allegiance.

 STATEMENT OF  The City of Santa Monica Statement of Accountability (Land
 ACCOUNTABILITY  Acknowledgement) was read into the record by Mayor Torosis.
 (LAND
 ACKNOWLEDGEMENT)
 Councilmember Hall arrived
 at 5:34 p.m.

 LEVINE ACT  No Councilmembers made disclosures regarding the Levine Act (Govt Code
 DISCLOSURE  Section 84308)

 PUBLIC INPUT FOR  There were no members of the public present to comment on Closed Session
 CLOSED SESSION ONLY: items.

 CLOSED SESSIONS  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 5:35 p.m., to consider
  Closed Sessions and returned at 8:07 p.m., with all members present, except,
  Mayor Pro Tem Zwick, to report the following:

  1  July 27, 2026
   5.A. Public employee appointment - Gov. Code § 54957(b): consider
  public employee appointment; title: City Clerk; Gov. Code § 54957.6:
  conference with labor negotiator; City negotiator: Mayor/Personnel
  Director; unrepresented employee: City Clerk

  The City Attorney reported that the Council has selected a final candidate,
  instructed the Mayor and HR Director to negotiate terms with the final
  candidate.

ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the special City Council meeting adjourned at 8:07
  p.m.

  ATTEST:  APPROVED:

  Denise Anderson-Warren  Caroline Torosis
  Interim City Clerk  Mayor

  2  July 27, 2026
